# CoGuava

> CoGuava is a business-partner matching platform. Its purpose is to help people find a compatible startup cofounder, franchise co-owner, local-business partner, or podcast co-host.

## What CoGuava does

- Matches you by what you want to build, location, contribution, experience, desired involvement, and timeline.
- Helps people in the same city combine complementary capital, skills, experience, ideas, and time.
- Helps you discover nearby people who want to build the same thing—even if you might never otherwise meet.
- Uses mutual interest before opening a private conversation.
- Is designed around identity checks, clear intentions, and private, consent-based verification.

## Primary use cases

- Find a startup cofounder.
- Find a franchise partner or franchise co-owner.
- Find a local small-business partner for a brick-and-mortar business.
- Find a podcast co-host.

## Important limitations

CoGuava is a matching and introduction platform. It does not guarantee business success, process investments, sell ownership interests, or replace legal, financial, franchise, or business due diligence.

## Core message

Your cofounder, found. Find your business soulmate and build something real together.
